messages.body_plain:
Hello,

Our student Vijay Barve started a blog recently to write about his work: http://vijaybarve.wordpress.com/. His code is at github here <https://github.com/vijaybarve/rvertnet> and here <https://github.com/vijaybarve/rgbif>. We know that the R project submits the blog posts to Google, but we thought you may be interested in Vijay's posts.

Thanks,
Scott Chamberlain
rOpenSci (http://ropensci.org/)
